summary: Full backend + frontend regression for iteration 10. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests PASSED covering anime catalog (25 anime, 44 locations, facets, genre=Music -> 3, q=frieren), auth security (weak-password 422, HTML-sanitized name, wrong-password 401), community CRUD (create/list/like toggle/comment, sanitization, auth-required), and marketplace hotels/events (>=8 hotels, city+max_price+sort filters, >=6 events sorted by date, authed booking returns pending, unauthed 401). Frontend: Landing shows Navbar with lang-toggle button; toggling switches hero title EN -> JP ('あなたの好きな…'). All 8 nav links (Explore/Atlas/Planner/Companion/Taste/Passport/Stories/Market) render. Explore page filters work (search 'love' -> 1 result, Clear -> 25). Community 'Share Your Journey' -> post appears at top of feed. Marketplace tabs switch, Reserve -> Reserved toast fires. TripShare /trip/{slug} shows Copy Link + Add to Calendar + Download PDF; clicking Download PDF triggers a client-side jsPDF download ('Quick Test Trip.pdf'). Iter 9 blocker (Navbar missing on Landing) is fully resolved.

issues: Nav labels wrap awkwardly around 1024–1280px viewport because each link has both EN + JP words (e.g. 'Planner 計画'). At 1440px it's fine, at 1024px labels break into 2 lines and crowd the toggle. Consider hiding JP subtitle at md breakpoint.
Hotel and event cards lack per-card data-testids like hotel-card-{id}; only Reserve button is testable. Add data-testid='hotel-card-{id}' / 'event-card-{id}' for better test targeting.
